correctness.rationale: Under the stated HOMFLY–PT normalization P_K(1,z)=Conway_K(z), so dDelta=span Delta=deg Conway <= dH=deg_z HOMFLY. The standard Ozsvath–Szabo and Rasmussen slice-genus inequalities give 2|tau|<=2g4<=2g and |s|<=2g4<=2g. Failure of either candidate therefore forces dDelta<2|tau| or dDelta<|s| respectively, hence dDelta<2g. For knot Alexander polynomials the span dDelta is even, so 2g-dDelta>=2. If dDelta=2g neither candidate can fail. Fibered knots satisfy Alexander span=2g. These are mathematically correct elementary implications; finite verifier.py is merely numerical arithmetic sanity check.
